title: Each Bob chat is its own agent on the map

outcome: LazyCop watches one Bob chat at a time; a second /lazycop ends the first.
Each Bob chat that runs /lazycop is watched as its own agent, with its own cards, messages and hold, while the other chats stay watched.
forbid: one agent's behaviour stays what onHook/onMcp do today — the existing engine tests pass unedited
hooks still fail open and never wait on the server (invariant 1); lazycop's own MCP tools are never blocked (invariant 2)

outcome: Every LazyCop MCP call lands on the agent of the chat that made it, matched through that chat's PreToolUse hook.
forbid: no change to the Bob-facing MCP tool signatures or the hook script

outcome: Each agent's records go to the .lazycop folder of its own chat's workspace.
Every page event from an agent names that agent, and the page snapshot lists every agent.
forbid: contract types change only in packages/contracts (invariant 6)

outcome: Every agent walks the tactical map as its own soldier, on places the whole squad shares.
The developer switches the page between agents, and cards, messages and hold act on the agent in focus.
Invariant 7 in docs/reference/architecture.md describes watching several chats as separate agents.

evidence: squad.ts keeps one StoreState per Bob session_id; squad tests: two chats watched at once, hold on chat-b blocks only chat-b, ending one leaves the other watched; the 88 pre-existing tests pass with hook.ts/mcp.ts/tests unchanged

routeMcp matches each MCP call to the own-tool PreToolUse hook by tool+stable args (then oldest same-tool hook); squad test fires B's hook then A's and gets the mcp events tagged chat-a, chat-b in call order; mcp-server.ts and hook-script.ts unchanged
logger scopes records with AsyncLocalStorage per agent call; squad test writes events for two chats into two temp workspaces' .lazycop/events.jsonl, one each
contracts: FromAgent tag on every non-state SseEvent, AgentInfo list on the snapshot, agent on QueueBody/HoldBody; CDP run shows the page folding 3 agents from the snapshot
buildSquadMap shares places across agents (squad-view test); CDP frames show BOB-1 and BOB-2 walking at once in their own colours, BOB-3 faded at the drop zone after end_session
squad bar and map clicks set the focus; after focusing BOB-1 the HUD button reads RESUME (its hold), the battle dialog hides (no card), and hold/queue posts carry the focused agent id
Invariant 7 rewritten in place: per-chat agents keyed by session_id, MCP matched through PreToolUse, solo agent without hooks, subagents share their root chat's session_id (Bob 2.2.0)

disposition: Shipped: every Bob chat running /lazycop is its own agent (engine squad layer, per-agent hold/cards/messages/records), events tagged by agent, and the page shows the squad on one map with a focus switcher. Subagents/subtasks still fold into their chat's agent — Bob gives them no separate session_id.
